Subject: Remember - you never need a PIN to receive money

Dear Customer, fraudsters are sending QR codes and 'collect requests' claiming you will receive money for something you are selling. Scanning a QR code or entering your UPI PIN always sends money from your account; it never brings money in. If a buyer insists on this, stop the deal. Report suspicious requests in your UPI app. - Digital Banking Team, Your Bank
